description: Returns one product's full test-drive result (20 to 70 KB; brief: true for the headline in about 3 KB): how far an agent gets with it and where it stops. slug: its directory slug from search_tools, or its name or domain (e.g. 'Postmark' or 'monday.com'); an unknown one is an error that names the closest. The full result: the agent level, the five outcomes (find, access, use, pay, leave, by any way in the product offers; stages: the four that decide the level, under their older keys), how an agent gets in (access, with the core tasks done on each way), the part scores, the nine checkpoints from docs to delete, what an agent can and cannot do, tips for agents, pay_options (the ways to pay it offers an agent, the payment our side proved with its transaction, and what the owner could add), the bot check that stopped our agent on a way in, even where it got in another way (agent_check: vendor, step, type network or challenge, the owner's fix), after_wall and works_assisted (what it did once a person helped; never part of the level), robots (a robots.txt rule on the way in; held: the level is from the last drive past it), same_level_drives of drives, the level history with why each move happened (product; agent: our agent or its drive changed; rules; noise), rules_date: the date of the rules the level was set by, audited: its certificate, if any (state, level, dates). From the rules of 12 Oct 2026 on: routes (every way in it offers and what happened on each, tried agent-native first), checkout (how far the walk to the last click went and what the checkout showed), docs (its docs read and judged) and claims (the documented ways to do the core work, tried once each: held, broken, worked but undocumented). newer_drives (drives after the listed one, not listed yet); attempts_count; the attempt log, with its evidence, is detail.url (a Builder or Team plan, or detail.per_product for this product alone).

brief.description: true: only the headline: level, where it stopped and why, the five outcomes, how an agent gets in, what it can and can't do, tips for agents, the level's history and the page

slug.description: The product's directory slug from search_tools (e.g. 'attio'), or its name or domain
